solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Facts, at short notice, presented the wrong way

indicators.note: shown back to front, so the letters built from the rest of the clue are read in reverse

parts.note: an ad, short for advertisement, is a notice

explanation.surface: Information sprung on someone at the last minute and garbled in the telling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short notice' is not about time: a notice shortened is an AD. AT and AD together, read backwards, give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are pieces of information or figures, the plural of datum, so facts serves as a plain synonym.

clue.text: Some milk about to turn up as treat for kitten

indicators.note: in a down answer, turning up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a pinta is British slang for a pint of milk, from the old 'Drinka Pinta Milka Day' advertising
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A saucer of milk set down as a reward for a young cat.
explanation.walkthrough: PINTA is British slang for a pint of milk, from a famous 1950s campaign; with C after it, the whole reads upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Catnip is a herb whose scent excites cats, so owners give it to a kitten as a treat.

clue.text: In dominant position throughout ambassadorship?

parts.note: the word ambassadorship runs from its first letter A to its last letter P, so 'A to P' covers it throughout

explanation.surface: A diplomat holding sway for the whole of a posting abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as A TO P: those are the bounds of the word 'ambassadorship', which runs from A to P, so the phrase spans it throughout.
explanation.definitionFit: Atop means on the top of something, which is the superior or commanding place.

clue.text: Business listed in Copenhagen Danes located

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words that follow, spanning two of them
says the answer is to be found placed within the stretch of clue words named

explanation.surface: Commercial firms on a directory of companies in Denmark's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is the list of items to be discussed at a meeting, the order of business.

clue.text: Show up at organisation as unorthodox leader

indicators.note: arranging or organising the letters puts them in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A maverick boss turns up at a company, making an appearance.
explanation.walkthrough: A southpaw is a left-handed boxer, who leads with the right hand: unorthodox in boxing terms, hence the 'unorthodox leader'.
explanation.definitionFit: Boxers normally lead with the left; a left-handed fighter in the opposite stance is called unorthodox.

clue.text: Closely study form, for a change

parts.note: to con is to study or learn carefully
a version is one particular form of something

explanation.surface: Pore over the racing form before switching your bet.
explanation.definitionFit: A conversion is a change from one state, use or belief to another.

clue.text: Problem with vision producing fall

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a clouding of the eye's lens

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names both an eye condition that clouds sight and a great cascade of water.

clue.text: Serves the purpose, since covering all the main points, right?

indicators.note: the outer word wraps around and covers the letters that follow

parts.note: as can mean since, because
the four main compass points are North, South, West and East

explanation.surface: A summary that touches every key point does its job, doesn't it?
explanation.definitionFit: To answer a need or purpose is to satisfy or be adequate for it.

clue.text: Russian author securing ring for many millions

indicators.note: the author's name holds the ring fast within it

parts.note: Nikolai Gogol wrote Dead Souls
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A Russian writer guarding a ring worth a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A googol is ten to the power of a hundred, a vast number far beyond many millions.

clue.text: Resort in which completed film is set, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the letters come from a spoken word with a matching pronunciation

parts.words: in which completed film is set
parts.note: finished film is said to be 'in the can', so cans are what it is put in

explanation.surface: A seaside town that hosts finished movies, famous for its festival.
explanation.walkthrough: Film stock is stored in round metal cans; a finished film is 'in the can'. Cannes, the French Riviera resort, hosts a famous film festival.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannes is a fashionable holiday resort on the French Riviera.

clue.text: Page one I have shortened, imposing discipline

parts.note: a unit is a single thing, one
I have contracted is I've, here without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A school page condensed into a strict set of rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Punitive measures inflict punishment, so they impose discipline on wrongdoers.

clue.text: Cheeky youngster, one who flogs fish

parts.note: a whipper is someone who whips or flogs
the snapper is a sea fish

explanation.surface: An impudent child who thrashes fish, or sells them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flogs' could mean sells; here it means whips.
explanation.definitionFit: A whippersnapper is an impertinent, presumptuous young person.

clue.text: Some beer admiral put in the hold

parts.note: a half is half a pint of beer
Horatio Nelson was the famous British admiral

explanation.surface: A naval officer drinking beer stowed below deck in a ship's hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hold' looks like a ship's cargo space but is a wrestling grip.
explanation.definitionFit: A half nelson is a wrestling grip, one arm locked under the opponent's arm and behind the neck.

clue.text: Do what you're doing, as opposed to cutting fish

indicators.note: the letter slices into the fish's name, sitting inside it

parts.note: sole is a flatfish
V stands for versus, meaning against or as opposed to

explanation.surface: An instruction to stick to your current task rather than filleting fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do what you're doing' addresses the solver: what you are doing is working out this clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A solver of a crossword is trying to work out the answers, so solving is the activity in hand.

clue.text: Card, not red, for striker

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a playing card of one of the black suits
second meaning: a heavy stick used for hitting

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a football referee's yellow or red card for a striker; instead it is a suit and a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Clubs are a black suit in a pack of cards, and a club is also a cudgel for hitting with.

clue.text: Malt liquor, including very mature drink

indicators.note: the liquor takes the letter in among its own

parts.note: beer is brewed from malt
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: A well-aged malt spirit served as a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A beverage is any drinkable liquid other than water, a general word for a drink.

clue.text: Influenced to such an extent, did some work at last

parts.note: so means to such a degree
led means guided or influenced

explanation.surface: Someone so swayed that they finally got round to doing a little work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' is not 'finally': a last is a cobbler's shoe-shaped form, on which shoes are soled.
explanation.definitionFit: A cobbler working at the last fits new soles to shoes, so soled is a cobbler's job done.

clue.text: Legislative body on a railway, concerned with fare intake

parts.note: a diet is a legislative assembly, as in Japan or historically Germany

explanation.surface: A parliament debating a railway, worried about passenger ticket revenue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fare' suggests train tickets beside 'railway', but here it means food.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietary means relating to diet, the food one eats, here called fare.

clue.text: Hold back ace, put in joker

indicators.note: the ace goes inside the joker's letters

parts.note: a wit is a joker, a funny person
A is the card abbreviation for ace

explanation.surface: A card player holding the ace in reserve and playing the joker instead.
explanation.definitionFit: To wait is to hold back or delay acting until the right moment.

clue.text: Fly endlessly in situation too good to be true

definitions.text: situation too good to be true

parts.note: something that flies forever will never, never come down to land

explanation.surface: Soaring forever in an idyllic dream world.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into NEVER NEVER LAND: a flyer who keeps going endlessly never lands. Peter Pan's island gives the idea of flying there.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes an imaginary, idealised place or state that could not exist in reality.

clue.text: Doctor concealing anger when upset in this respect

indicators.note: in a down answer, upset means turned upside down, so the letters read upwards
the doctor's letters wrap around and hide the anger

parts.note: rage is fierce anger

explanation.surface: A medic hiding his fury when distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' is only a link. 'respect' is the definition in the sense of 'in this regard', meaning in this respect.
explanation.definitionFit: Regard is a respect or aspect, as in 'in this regard'.

clue.text: Threaten to produce overflow in computer

definitions.meaning: first meaning, split as two words: liquid that laps the top of its container is on the point of spilling over
second meaning: a portable personal computer

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer 3,3: water that laps the top of a vessel is about to spill. Whole, it is a portable computer.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a portable personal computer small enough to rest on a user's knees.

clue.text: Error-free statement of agreement

definitions.meaning: second meaning: an expression of consent, like OK

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both correct in every detail and a spoken assent such as yes or okay.

clue.text: Part of Africa still ahead for traveller

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a West African country
second meaning, split 2,2: the distance a traveller has left ...

explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a small West African nation; read as two words it is the stretch of journey remaining.

clue.text: Way of viewing power in a faction

indicators.note: the power letter is placed inside the faction

parts.note: a sect is a faction or breakaway group
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A political faction's outlook on who holds power.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a particular side or angle from which something is considered.

clue.text: Prepare to swallow cold chop

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
to hew is to chop with an axe

explanation.surface: Get ready to eat a chilled lamb chop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chop' looks like a cut of meat, which fits 'swallow', but here it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Chewing breaks food down in the mouth so it can be swallowed.

clue.text: Metalworker, one who makes lots of money illegally

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who works metal at a forge

definitions.text: one who makes lots of money illegally
definitions.meaning: second meaning: a counterfeiter of banknotes

explanation.definitionFit: A smith forges iron; a counterfeiter forges notes, so the noun covers both trades.

clue.text: Supporters in camp set about covering operation in hospital

indicators.note: placed in, so the inner group is set within the hospital's name

parts.note: Guy's is a well-known London teaching hospital

indicators.note: the word for about wraps around the operation

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Fans at a summer camp rallying round someone having surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: Guy's is a well-known London teaching hospital. 'Supporters' sounds like fans, but here it means the ropes that hold up a tent.
explanation.definitionFit: Guy ropes are the tensioned lines that hold a tent upright, supporting it at a campsite.
